title: Wild Mushroom Pasta
description: A keto pasta dish featuring wild mushrooms and a delicate sauce. Perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
Melt 1 tbsp of butter in a pan over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add wild mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp of butter until melted.
Drain pasta and add to the pan with the mushroom sauce.
Toss pasta to coat with the sauce and serve immediately.
